name: sharepoint
description: SharePoint Online integration via Microsoft Graph — search and resolve sites, browse lists, query and read list items, search document libraries, and create or update list items. Uses app-only (client-credentials) auth with an Azure AD app registration; requires Sites.Read.All application permission with admin consent (Sites.ReadWrite.All to enable the write tools).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: SharePoint Online sites, lists, and files via Microsoft Graph (app-only)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) of your Microsoft 365 organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the app registration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. Requires the Sites.Read.All application permission with admin consent; Sites.ReadWrite.All to enable the write tools.

tools.name: sp.search_sites
tools.description: Search SharePoint sites across the tenant by keyword and return their ids, display names, and web URLs.

query.description: Keyword to search site names for (use * to list sites)

tools.name: sp.get_site
tools.description: Resolve a SharePoint site by its hostname and server-relative path (e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com + sites/Marketing). Works even for tenants that lock down site search.

path.description: Server-relative site path (e.g. sites/Marketing or teams/Engineering)

tools.name: sp.list_lists
tools.description: List the lists (including document libraries) in a SharePoint site with their ids, display names, and list templates.

siteId.description: The site id (from sp.search_sites or sp.get_site)

tools.name: sp.query_list_items
tools.description: Query the items of a SharePoint list, returning each item's column fields. Supports an optional OData $filter and follows result pages up to a cap.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. fields/Status eq 'Active' (the column usually must be indexed)

tools.name: sp.get_list_item
tools.description: Get a single SharePoint list item by id, including all of its column fields.

tools.name: sp.search_files
tools.description: Search the site's default document library for files by keyword and return name, web URL, size, and last-modified time.

siteId.description: The site id whose default document library to search

query.description: Keyword to search file and folder names/content for

tools.name: sp.create_list_item
tools.description: Create a new item in a SharePoint list with the given column fields.

fields.description: Column name -> value map for the new item, e.g. {"Title": "New task", "Status": "Active"}

tools.name: sp.update_list_item
tools.description: Update the column fields of an existing SharePoint list item.

itemId.description: The list item id to update

fields.description: Column name -> value map of the fields to change
